reason: Pre-headline reader validation established reproducible numeric paths for every primary survey. San Emidio is restricted to its public DataCube AU4 raw subset because the SmartSolo DLD path in the authors' workflow depends on proprietary vendor tooling. EGS Collab Experiment 2 is restricted to its public HDF5 waveform subset because the archive mixes HDF5 and TDMS containers while the HDF5 subset alone comfortably exceeds the frozen >25 GB threshold and has a verified /data_product/data schema. These are execution-format restrictions within the same surveys, made before any frozen headline survey compression result and without inspecting signal statistics or headline compression outputs.

land_san_emidio_2021.name: WHOLESCALE San Emidio Nevada 2021 DataCube raw level-0
land_san_emidio_2021.test_policy: 3x >=10GB deterministic spans over complete native DataCube level-0 .AU4 waveform members inside the public TAR archive
land_san_emidio_2021.note: Raw DataCube only. SmartSolo DLD is excluded solely because the documented conversion path depends on proprietary vendor tooling; processed SAC is not used.

das_egs_collab_exp2.test_policy: 3x >=10GB deterministic spans over complete public HDF5 waveform files
das_egs_collab_exp2.note: Primary benchmark uses the HDF5 subset only. TDMS is excluded as a container-format simplification before headline results; this does not change the survey or use signal/compression statistics for selection.
